name: CDP Pilot
description: QA pilot for a configured Electron app on a linked remote host: launch a signature-verified build with a disposable profile and a loopback-only ephemeral debug port, inspect its DOM, click, type, press keys, screenshot, and close, over the Chrome DevTools Protocol with no macOS TCC permissions. Named-target allowlist (default empty); no arbitrary JavaScript, raw CDP, profile copies or host/path/port parameters.

skills.description: Drive a configured Electron app on a linked remote host for QA over CDP: launch with a disposable profile, inspect, click, type, key, screenshot, close, and verify cleanup. Use when asked to exercise or screenshot AW Desktop on the Mac mini without macOS screen/accessibility permissions.

targets.description: Allowlist of launchable apps. EMPTY by default: with no targets every launch is refused. Each entry: name, host_id (a linked remote host), app_path (absolute path of the .app, must be its own realpath), bundle_id (CFBundleIdentifier, verified on the host), optional team_id (codesign TeamIdentifier, verified on the host).

session_ttl_s.description: Session lifetime in seconds before the host-side supervisor kills the app and removes its profile. Hard cap 1800.

screenshot_dir.description: Directory on THIS workspace where captured PNGs land, relative to the workspace root.

apps.reason: This app contributes an mcp.json entry (the 'aw-cdp-pilot' server) that MCP Gateway discovers and merges; without the gateway no agent can reach its tools.
